lines.text: Post a message: sends a message through Slack.
Post a message: can reach people outside your company.
Post a message: a Card's "Only for" can name which channel it acts on.
Post a message: after each call, KIFF reads it back from Slack to check it took effect.
Post a message: if an answer is lost, KIFF can't check whether it happened, so it stays counted.
Read a channel: reads from Slack, changes nothing.
Slack's API isn't pinned to a version, so KIFF checks it daily.
